title: Design System: Agent Zero Browser Extension

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border and text color changes; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: status-transition
motion.purpose: Persistent status color feedback; removed for reduced motion.

extensions.reviewScope: SHIP for synthetic limited-development-ready desktop options, narrow options and narrow side-panel captures. Not fresh-install, live browser-effects, all-state or full production acceptance. Detector warnings concerned inherited Roboto Mono use.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: A compact next action, with a larger narrow or coarse-pointer target.

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: A neutral secondary action with a restrained border.

components.name: Disconnect button
components.description: The quiet action geometry with semantic danger text.

components.name: Pairing input
components.description: Labeled pairing field using the shared neutral control surface.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-server">Agent Zero address</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-server" type="url" placeholder="http://localhost:50080">

components.name: Task navigation
components.description: The native task selector appears when authorized tasks are available; this preview is illustrative.
components.html: <label class="ds-nav-label" for="ds-task">Selected Agent Zero task</label><select class="ds-nav" id="ds-task"><option>Choose a task</option></select>

components.name: Development label
components.description: A non-interactive build-channel label, never a readiness badge.

components.name: Notice container
components.description: A flat tonal notice within the open section hierarchy.
components.html: Checking existing browser tabs before enabling control.

narrative.overview: The extension follows the user's confirmed Agent Zero identity: local Rubik and Roboto Mono, dark neutral surfaces, compact blue controls, and plain connection guidance. It is quiet and technical, with clear status and a practical next action. Rows, restrained borders, and disclosures carry the hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Native Agent Zero typography and dark neutral surfaces.
Compact blue actions and readable connection rows.
Plain pairing guidance with installation and diagnostics in disclosures.
Status language that preserves the actual control boundary.

rules.name: The Status Truth Rule
rules.body: Pairing, limited browser control, and full task/chat readiness remain distinct. Text and icon shape must explain state; color alone must never claim a capability.

dos: Do preserve local Rubik and Roboto Mono, neutral dark surfaces, and compact blue actions.
Do explain that pairing is saved once per Chrome profile across ordinary restarts.
Do keep browser selection and site approvals separate from saved pairing.
Do keep reduced-motion feedback visible and keyboard focus explicit.
Do describe limited browser control with its actual supported and unavailable actions.
donts: Don't introduce a new visual identity, decorative card stacks, or dashboard styling.
Don't promote synthetic visual approval to production or fresh-install acceptance.
Don't expose credentials or internal admission identities as setup guidance.
